title: The Ext boundary is the prescribed horseshoe section boundary
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme, $T=(F_1\to F_2\to F_3)$ a short exact sequence of abelian sheaves, and $I_j$ injective resolutions of $F_j$. Let $\alpha:I_1\to I_2$, $\beta:I_2\to I_3$ commute with the augmentations, satisfy $\alpha\beta=0$, and give short exact rows in every degree. Let $S$ be the global section sequence and assume it is short exact. Fix $q\in\mathbb N$ and isomorphisms $e_1:H^{q+1}(X,F_1)\simeq H^{q+1}(\Gamma(X,I_1))$, $e_3:H^q(X,F_3)\simeq H^q(\Gamma(X,I_3))$ satisfying the cocycle representative property of [lem-pc-abelian-cech-ext-section-iso]: every Ext class t has a cocycle a from the constant lifted integral sheaf and a section cycle z, with extMk(a)=t, adjunction evaluated on 1 equal to iCycles(z), and e(t)=homologyπ(z). Then $\delta_{\mathrm{Ext}}e_1=e_3\delta_S$, where the left boundary is Sheaf.functorHδ and the right boundary is the homology connecting map of S. The section complexes are [def-pc-abelian-cech-comparison-construction]. No opens, covering, Cech complex or total complex occurs in this statement.

proof.text: Choose c, its cocycle proof and z3 from he3. Split the degree-q row using injectivity of I1 in that degree, and define b as c composed with the section. The cochain-map equation for beta shows db maps to zero. Use the kernel lift from short exactness to define a in degree q+1. Its next differential vanishes by monicity of the next alpha component and d squared equal to zero. Apply extMk_resolution_connecting_eq_triangle in the standard Ext universe. Rewrite its left side by Ext.preadditiveCoyoneda_homologySequenceδ_singleTriangle_apply. Apply Ext.ext to the small-universe desired equation and rewrite comp_hom, extClass_hom and extMk_hom: both universe versions become the same morphism equation in the standard derived category.

The section of a is a cycle by abelianCech_ext_section_cycle. Apply naturality of the constant-sheaf adjunction to c, b, a and their differentials, and evaluate at the generator 1. This gives a section cocycle x3, a lift x2, and a factor x1 with alpha(x1)=d(x2). Apply Mathlib ShortExact.δ_apply (the concrete form of the connecting formula), using the identity forgetful functor on additive groups. Monicity of the cycle inclusions identifies its cyclesMk representatives with the supplied z3 and z1. Thus the section boundary of [z3] is [z1]. The construction and formula work without negative degrees when q=0.

Put y=[z1] and apply he1 to e1.inv(y). The isomorphism equation identifies the section class of its representative a-prime with y. The proved section-homology injectivity lemma identifies extMk(a-prime) with extMk(a), so applying e1.hom gives e1.hom(extMk(a))=y. Substitute the Ext boundary cocycle calculation and the he3 representative equation. Equality on every input t proves equality of the additive morphisms by extensionality.

theorem abelianCechExtSection_boundary
    {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (T : ShortComplex (Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}))
    (hT : T.ShortExact)
    (I₁ : InjectiveResolution T.X₁) (I₂ : InjectiveResolution T.X₂)
    (I₃ : InjectiveResolution T.X₃)
    (α : I₁.cocomplex ⟶ I₂.cocomplex) (β : I₂.cocomplex ⟶ I₃.cocomplex)
    (hαβ : α ≫ β = 0)
    (hα : I₁.ι ≫ α = (CochainComplex.single₀ _).map T.f ≫ I₂.ι)
    (hβ : I₂.ι ≫ β = (CochainComplex.single₀ _).map T.g ≫ I₃.ι)
    (hrows : ∀ n : ℕ, ((ShortComplex.mk α β hαβ).map
      (HomologicalComplex.eval _ (.up ℕ) n)).ShortExact)
    (hS : ((ShortComplex.mk α β hαβ).map
      ((sheafToPresheaf _ _ ⋙ (CategoryTheory.evaluation _ _).obj
        (op (⊤ : X.Opens))).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℕ))).ShortExact)
    (q : ℕ)
    (e₁ : (Sheaf.functorH (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) (q + 1)).obj T.X₁ ≅
      (abelianCechSections I₁).homology (q + 1))
    (e₃ : (Sheaf.functorH (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) q).obj T.X₃ ≅
      (abelianCechSections I₃).homology q)
    (he₁ : ∀ (t : (Sheaf.functorH (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) (q + 1)).obj T.X₁),
      ∃ (a : (constantSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
          (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u} ℤ)) ⟶ I₁.cocomplex.X (q + 1))
        (ha : a ≫ I₁.cocomplex.d (q + 1) ((q + 1) + 1) = 0)
        (z : (abelianCechSections I₁).cycles (q + 1)),
        I₁.extMk a ((q + 1) + 1) rfl ha = t ∧
        ((constantSheafAdj (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}
          isTerminalTop).homEquiv _ _ a) (ULift.up 1) =
            (abelianCechSections I₁).iCycles (q + 1) z ∧
        e₁.hom t = (abelianCechSections I₁).homologyπ (q + 1) z)
    (he₃ : ∀ (t : (Sheaf.functorH (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) q).obj T.X₃),
      ∃ (a : (constantSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
          (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u} ℤ)) ⟶ I₃.cocomplex.X q)
        (ha : a ≫ I₃.cocomplex.d q (q + 1) = 0)
        (z : (abelianCechSections I₃).cycles q),
        I₃.extMk a (q + 1) rfl ha = t ∧
        ((constantSheafAdj (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}
          isTerminalTop).homEquiv _ _ a) (ULift.up 1) =
            (abelianCechSections I₃).iCycles q z ∧
        e₃.hom t = (abelianCechSections I₃).homologyπ q z) :
    Sheaf.functorHδ hT q ≫ e₁.hom = e₃.hom ≫ hS.δ q (q + 1) rfl
